name: trading-research-system
description: Focused trading research skills for weekly reviews, daily tracking, setup scans, trade review, and risk checks.

interface.shortDescription: Weekly reviews, daily tracking, trade review, and risk workflows.
interface.longDescription: Trading Research System gives Codex a focused skill set for disciplined trading research: review last week's trades, analyze current market tape, macro, policy, news, and upcoming events, update momentum rankings, build next-week trading plans, track the current market against those plans, apply high-level Al Brooks price action timing, capture post-order and post-exit trade reviews, check portfolio risk exposure, and review trading statistics.
defaultPrompt: Build my weekly market review and next-week trading plan.
Track today's market and update active trade levels.
Screen stocks for a falling-rate environment.
Review my latest IBKR trade interactively.
